note: One row per capability, at the HIGHEST level its evidence supports and no higher. A row at functionally-validated or above names the command that re-establishes it. Generated evidence under sim/build/ is listed as such and is not in Git. Stage 1 cannot contain board-measured.

entries.claim: 45/45 original TileBench operators, 149/149 cases/stages at each of O0/O1/O2 through compile_aot + Session on core-sim
entries.limits: small explicit RTL configurations; not arbitrary tiles, K ranges or launch options

entries.claim: device cycles per case, deterministic on the fast memory model, recorded as a frozen baseline
entries.limits: serial-grid: the runtime launches one program at a time and adds cycles; not device throughput

entries.claim: compile_aot -> .tnca -> Session is the path every R38 number takes
device-side concurrent grid scheduling
entries.limits: Session._run_one launches programs serially with role_mask=1

entries.claim: TNCA MLIR dialect and async ownership verifier exist
entries.limits: not established that every public-AOT compile passes through a unified MLIR pipeline (roadmap 1.1)

entries.claim: 20 device counters (spec/r38/counters.json) readable per program through transport op 7 and Session(counters=True); exclusive-stall, retired and run-window identities hold on every program of all 149 O2 cases on core-sim and core-vrf-sync-v1
entries.limits: single core, simulation transport; board counters (DRAM controller, NoC) are Stage 2

entries.claim: public-AOT softmax and histogram at O2 pass on delayed/reordered memory
FP32 dot vector expansion and part of INT8 on float paths are functional fallbacks, not native capability
strict bounds, E/A/S/U/AQ and the appendix A self-checks
entries.limits: S1-05 not accepted until section 4.10.9 item 7 (degraded RTL) passes

entries.claim: generic yosys gate/depth/flop counts
entries.limits: no PDK and no FPGA flow: not mm^2, GHz or watts

entries.claim: any FPGA place-and-route, bitstream or board measurement
entries.limits: R36 IMPLEMENTED / NOT ACCEPTED; board work is Stage 2

entries.claim: 2x2 mesh with NUCA and NoC
entries.limits: no scaling result; 16-tile figures in the architecture overview are design proposals

entries.claim: single-core serial-grid analytical cost model; held-out median error 0.0%, P90 7.3%, Spearman 0.999, 90% interval coverage 0.88
entries.limits: held-out families contain no GEMM, transpose, softmax or rmsnorm family; operators outside its declared structure are refused

entries.claim: ISA sec 9E mod[5] transposed tensor-DMA write (16-bit, 4/8/16 source rows) on profile core-xpose-v1, used by the compiler for tl.trans of descriptor tiles; FP16 GEMM 16x16x32 13549 -> 9249 cycles
entries.limits: serial-grid cycles on the simulation bench; structural proxy +4734 gates / +1089 flops on tnca_tensor, no Fmax or FPGA resource yet (Stage 2)

entries.claim: R36-BUILD-01..03 including the fresh-environment package cases, with the R38 changes
entries.limits: run on the x86_64 acceptance-platform host; the Darwin/arm64 development machine cannot install the pinned Triton

entries.claim: torch.compile -> Inductor -> Triton -> tnca backend plugin -> Session: 12 small graphs (elementwise, fused activation, reductions, softmax incl. NaN, RMSNorm, GEMM, GEMM+RMSNorm+SiLU, views, in-place) match eager CPU with zero host fallback; R3.7 149/149 through native kernel[grid]; plugin and compile_aot code segments byte-identical at O0/O1/O2
entries.limits: blocks capped at 16 elements (small shapes); host tensors uploaded/downloaded per launch; PyTorch in its own environment (spec/r38/torch.lock.json)

entries.claim: The U50 board support of branch fpga-u50 (U50Backend over XRT, fpga-u50-sim on the same RTL, AXI-Lite adapter, board top, Vitis package/link/program flow) merged into r38; the board wrapper elaborates, connects and passes its benches against the r38 shell
entries.limits: the image on the board was built before the merge (flow/fpga/README.md); a rebuilt image is board-measured only in Stage 2 (doc/r38_board_bringup.md)

entries.claim: Transport 1.1 op 7 PERF_READ on the board's register protocol (tnca_mmio -> tnca_shell perf_sel/perf_rdata): counters in 32-bit halves, an out-of-range index refused; Session(counters=True) through U50Backend satisfies the S1-02 conservation, retired and window identities
entries.limits: the probe cases (quick) through fpga-u50-sim; on the board after the image is rebuilt (Stage 2)

entries.claim: ArchBench at the PyTorch level: 76 points (27 tiny, 25 small, 24 large; LLM operators, general operators, LLaMA prefill/decode, GPT-2 block, MLP, ResNet block), frozen by content hash; strict bounds for TNCA (cycles) and the GB10 GPU (seconds); E/A/S through the Stage 1 scorer; declared MACs never exceed torch's FLOP counter and bytes match the tensors
entries.limits: the GB10 tensor-core peak is an upper estimate (specs/gpu_gb10.json); GPU records are measured-gpu, not a TNCA evidence level

entries.claim: Every tiny and small ArchBench point compiles through torch.compile -> Inductor -> Triton -> tnca with zero host fallback (SDPA decomposition, int64 ids with checked narrowing, device asserts as traps, M=1 GEMM, one-row folds/scans, the 2-D boolean splat fix); tiny-tier numerics on the RTL in doc/r38_stage1_status.md
entries.limits: small-tier models are not simulated (hours to tens of hours per point at ~500 cycles/s) and are left to the board; blocks <= 16 per dimension; int64 emulated lane by lane

entries.claim: ArchBench points run through the board's software path (U50Backend, register protocol, tnca_fpga_top) on fpga-u50-sim, with device cycles identical to the simulation bench of profile core-vrf-sync-v1
entries.limits: a simulation of the board's top level; the board itself is Stage 2
